decisions.reason: The DPA management tool shows early positive feedback from agencies, fits the firm's compliance focus, and costs little to maintain, so keeping the option open is sensible.
As the flagship platform shown on the home page in both years, it is central to the firm's agency strategy and has already moved beyond an option into a core commitment.
The configurable managed hosting plan is close to the core business, is consistently presented on its own page, and is cheap to maintain alongside existing infrastructure.

Extended PHP security support is new and still uncertain, with only a mention on the website, but it is low cost and supports the security and compliance promise, so the option stays open while demand from legacy PHP users becomes clear.
